scope: Purposive public LHC reuse survey: 26 curated candidate routes plus 45 separately preserved ATLAS probability-model index entries. Counts overlap; neither is an exhaustive HEP census or a readiness score.
claim_boundary: All curated entries are candidates. No candidate was executed or newly scientifically validated by this survey. Execution tier identifies the nearest plausible route and remaining work, not permission to execute.

execution_tiers.E0: Discovery metadata only; no payload admission.
execution_tiers.E1: Existing Ravel statistical component is a plausible target after exact artifact/format/benchmark admission; end-to-end analysis readiness is not established.
execution_tiers.E2: Documented public artifact or external executable route, but a versioned adapter and scientific closure are required in Ravel.
execution_tiers.E3: New method/data-analysis work or major scientific contract development required; research planning only.

artifact_availability_levels.index_confirmed: Official/maintainer index lists the resource, payload uninspected.
artifact_availability_levels.paper_confirmed: Primary paper/page describes the artifact or result; payload uninspected.
artifact_availability_levels.repository_pinned: Public repository identity pinned; does not establish data/environment completeness.
artifact_availability_levels.metadata_confirmed: Record metadata inspected, referenced payloads uninspected.
artifact_availability_levels.file_manifest_confirmed: Named files/checksums present in inspected public metadata; bytes not fetched.
artifact_availability_levels.release_confirmed: Experiment announces public research release; per-analysis manifest absent.

curated_candidates.title: ATLAS 1905.04242: fiducial WW differential cross sections
missing_or_unverified_artifacts: Exact tables, bin correlations/covariances and compatible Rivet routine/version were not fetched.
model_limitations: Specify SMEFT basis, Wilson-coefficient units, perturbative order and truncation.
detector_limitations: Match particle-level dressing, jet veto and fiducial boundaries; unfolding assumes a response model.
statistical_limitations: Correlated Gaussian/likelihood fit; normalised distributions can have singular covariance. Avoid multiplying overlapping distributions.
admission_evidence_required: Recover SM reference distributions and covariance rank.
Validate signed interference plus quadratic terms and the accepted EFT validity region.

curated_candidates.title: CMS SMP-20-005 / 2111.13948: Wgamma differential EFT fit
missing_or_unverified_artifacts: Exact measured vector, covariance, theory templates and bin conventions.
model_limitations: O3W interference is a signed coefficient contribution; retain coefficient signs and linear/quadratic order.
detector_limitations: Reproduce photon isolation, lepton frame/angle definition and unfolding scope.
statistical_limitations: A positive signal-strength upper-limit solver cannot stand in for a coefficient fit with non-monotone dependence.
admission_evidence_required: Reproduce at least positive/negative coefficient reference predictions and confidence intervals.
Check total predictions are physical within the specified domain without clipping the interference term.

curated_candidates.title: ATLAS 2405.20041: unbinned Z+jets OmniFold measurement
missing_or_unverified_artifacts: Weighted-event payload, uncertainty replicas and usage restrictions remain to be inspected.
model_limitations: New observables must be functions of the measured representation, within the measured phase space.
detector_limitations: These unfolded events are not detector-level raw events; response-model dependence remains.
statistical_limitations: Preserve event weights and correlated uncertainty replicas; arbitrary histogram independence is invalid.
admission_evidence_required: Reproduce published observables from the released events.
Validate new observable closure and uncertainty propagation before an EFT or BSM fit.

curated_candidates.title: ATLAS TOPQ-2019-03: ttbar plus heavy-flavour differential measurement

model_limitations: Heavy-flavour scheme, shower and additional-jet definitions matter to EFT templates.
detector_limitations: Do not mix particle-level emu results with uncorrected detector yields.
statistical_limitations: Distinguish a measurement POI from a BSM signal-strength POI; respect bin correlations.
admission_evidence_required: Recover reference differential measurement and likelihood parameter semantics.

curated_candidates.title: ATLAS 2408.00049: boosted low-mass resonance plus photon
missing_or_unverified_artifacts: Exact spectra, nuisance/background-fit prescription and tagging/trigger response.
model_limitations: Published narrow spin-1 interpretation does not establish validity for broad widths or other spins.
detector_limitations: Photon trigger and two-prong large-radius jet selection require matched implementation.
statistical_limitations: Changing width changes shape, acceptance and possible interference; cross-section-only rescaling is insufficient.
admission_evidence_required: Recover narrow benchmark efficiencies and shape.
Admit broad widths only after valid shape and background-fit/coverage tests.

curated_candidates.title: ATLAS 1910.08447: inclusive and b-tagged dijet resonances
missing_or_unverified_artifacts: Exact Gaussian-width tables, detector response and shape-fit configuration.
model_limitations: Finite-width resonances, PDF tails and interference need not be Gaussian.
detector_limitations: Match mass resolution, high-pT flavour tagging and fiducial acceptance.
statistical_limitations: Gaussian-limit interpolation is allowed only inside the stated shape family; a smooth background fit is not independent Poisson bins.
admission_evidence_required: Validate reconstructed shape membership before applying a Gaussian limit.
For a new fit, recover background-fit choices and spurious-signal/coverage tests.

curated_candidates.title: ATLAS 2015/2016 research Open Data release
missing_or_unverified_artifacts: Choose concrete dataset records and analysis workflow; release-wide access is not an analysis manifest.
model_limitations: Specify a bounded physical observable/model before choosing files.
detector_limitations: Official object calibrations, trigger matching and data-quality selections are required.
statistical_limitations: Novel open-data measurements or anomaly studies require independent calibration and statistical validation.
admission_evidence_required: Pin dataset/file manifests, data-quality and luminosity records.
Reproduce one documented research analysis before admitting a new observable or model.

acceptance_policy: Admission requirements are reviewer proposals; current executable product contracts and run-specific approvals remain authoritative.
